I couldn't find that research. Searches of long-term memory (all scopes, including expired facts, in English and Russian) and of this repository turned up nothing on Larkspur and HTTP/3 or QUIC.

The only Larkspur fact on record is unrelated: its HTTP client's connection pool ignores `HTTP_PROXY`, so the proxy has to be set explicitly with `Client{Proxy: ...}`.

If you tell me where the Larkspur source or docs are, I can check HTTP/3 support directly and save the answer to memory.
